summary: This video reviews the October 9 patch notes for Dragonheir: Silent Gods, highlighting upcoming features for Season 9. Key updates include the pre-loading of the S9 scenario starting October 23, the introduction of a Server Transfer Pre-registration system, and major additions to Magichess such as new talents, treasures, and hero bond adjustments. The video also introduces the Glory Colosseum, a 3-team server-wide PvP mode launching in December. Finally, Suzi inspects the top Temporal Vortex league rankings, reacting to a surprising high-performing team utilizing Astaion as a tank.

heroes.name: Astaion
heroes.verdict: Surprising top-tier Temporal Vortex tank option
heroes.note: Featured as the front-line tank in the top league ranking Temporal Vortex team, providing crowd control and utility.

teams.note: Top league ranking team achieving high damage scores with Astaion absorbing damage up front.

meta_changes: Server Transfer Pre-registration allows players to request transfers to target servers using invitation codes during season settlement.
Glory Colosseum (Team Arena) returns as a 3-team server-wide PvP mode with weekly rotating battlefield effects and Legacy Coffer stat enhancements.
Magichess updates add the new Conqueror bond, the Reversal talent, 5 new treasures, and buffs to Bounty and Alchemy talents.
Magichess hero bond balance adjustments increase Fighter (2) shields to 75% max HP with debuff immunity, and cause Rogue heroes to explode on death dealing AoE damage and silence.
tips: Redeem any unused Prophecy Summon codes before the October 9 maintenance when the feature goes offline temporarily.
Use the new hero screen filter options to quickly identify heroes with upgradeable Inspiration or Talents.
title: Server Transfers & S9 Update NEWS ✅ Patch Notes🔥 Dragonheir x Dragonstride
